eSpeak NG – text-to-speech engine (offline voice reply of the shop assistant)
=============================================================================
Files: espeak-ng.js, espeak-fa.wasm.gz
Upstream: https://github.com/espeak-ng/espeak-ng (C sources)
Build used: npm package "espeak-ng" version 1.0.2 (https://www.npmjs.com/package/espeak-ng), compiled to WebAssembly with Emscripten.
License: GNU General Public License v3.0 or later (see LICENSE.txt in this folder).

Modification (Fratak, round 30): to keep the download small, the embedded voice data of all languages except
Persian (fa) and English (en) was zeroed inside espeak-ng.wasm; the result was gzip-compressed (espeak-fa.wasm.gz).
No code was changed. The complete corresponding source is the upstream repository/npm package above; the data
removal is reproducible by zeroing the "*_dict" files (other than fa_dict and en_dict) in the wasm data segments.

This engine runs only in the visitor's browser as an independent program (it is fetched on demand when the visitor
turns on spoken replies and the browser has no Persian voice). It is not linked into the shop's server code.
